<subject>Re: bulk commodities roundtable</subject>
<body>
Hi Jessica --

Ellen is a WA Resources Board member and we have invited two other WA Resources Board members. Assuming one of her colleagues, Morgan Blackburn or Austin Huang accept, there is not a need to send an alternate. We appreciate the offer though.

Thanks, MSA
</body>
<quoted>
-----Original Message-----
From: Maxwell, Jessica
Sent: Monday, July 22, 2024 11:47 AM
To: Gonzales, Michelle
Subject: FW: bulk commodities roundtable

FYI...

-----Original Message-----
From: "Fisher, Ellen" <ellen.fisher@northwestlogistics.com.au>
Sent: Monday, July 22, 2024 10:47 AM
To: Richmond, Darren
Subject: bulk commodities roundtable

Mr. Richmond,
Thank you for your kind invitation to participate in the interesting program that you are sponsoring in October. Unfortunately, I have a conflicting commitment and will be unable to attend. May I pass the information on to one of the other Board members here, or have you also invited others from our board?
Thank you.
Ellen Fisher
</quoted>
